newsitem.title: GREECE: Greece clears auto dealer Sfakianakis IPO.
newsitem.headline: Greece clears auto dealer Sfakianakis IPO.

text.p: Greece's capital market commission cleared the initial public offering prospectus of automobile trading company Sfakianakis for listing on the Athens bourse's main market.
Sfakianakis will issue 2,025,000 common bearer shares with a par value of 300 drachmas, as well as a 100,000 tranche which will be privately placed, it said in a statement.
The issue price will be announced at a later date. A proceeds target figure of four billion drachmas cited by Sfakianakis points to a share price close to 1,900 drachmas.
Lead underwriter to the issue is Alpha Credit Bank with N.Devletoglou Securities acting as the issue advisor.
Subscriptions for the IPO are slated for late May to early June 1997.
Selling mostly Suzuki vehicles, Sfakianakis was Greece's most profitable auto dealer in 1995, ranking 50th among all Greek corporations, it said.
Its 1996 pretax earnings rose 58 percent to 3.784 billion drachmas on turnover growth of 31 percent to 32.696 billion drachmas.
IPO proceeds will be mostly used for working capital linked with financing facilities offered to clients. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
